page_title: HookGenius — Suno Prompt Generator: Whole Songs, Lyrics & Style Prompts

sources.entry: HookGenius - AI lyrics and style prompt generator for Suno. Produces copy-paste-ready hooks, song structures, and genre-tuned style tags with artist-style references.

summary.name: HookGenius
summary.one_liner: HookGenius is a web app that turns a song idea, artist reference, or pasted lyrics into Suno-ready lyrics and style prompts, without generating any audio itself.
keywords: paste lyrics keep word for word
use_cases: Writing lyrics for a song to generate in Suno
Creating Suno style prompts with genre, tempo and instruments
Planning song structure and sections before generation
Writing duets or songs with featured verses
Drafting an album of connected tracks
Rewriting specific parts of an existing song
summary.what_it_does: HookGenius takes a plain-language idea, an artist or song to emulate, or the user's own lyrics, and produces two outputs for Suno's Custom mode: full lyrics with every section in order and voices cued, and a style prompt covering genre, tempo, instruments, vocal character and production. It writes in more than 40 languages, handles duets and featured verses, and can keep pasted lyrics unchanged on request. It can also plan an album of connected tracks. Mix, its producer feature, rewrites any part of a song the user points at. The user copies the output into Suno, which produces the audio; HookGenius states it does not generate audio and is not affiliated with Suno.
notable: Outputs lyrics and style prompts formatted for Suno's Custom mode, with no audio generation
Supports more than 40 languages and duets/featured verses
Mix producer feature rewrites chosen parts of a song
Can plan an album of connected tracks
caveats: Requires Suno to produce the actual audio; HookGenius is not affiliated with Suno
After the first free song, usage needs a monthly plan or one-time credit pack
